speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Where we do reign, we will alone uphold,

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Without the assistance of a mortal hand:

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: So tell the pope, all reverence set apart

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: To him and his usurpd authority.

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: Brother of England, you blaspheme in this.

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Though you and all the kings of Christendom

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Are led so grossly by this meddling priest,

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Dreading the curse that money may buy out;

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: And by the merit of vile gold, dross, dust,

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Purchase corrupted pardon of a man,

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Who in that sale sells pardon from himself,

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Though you and all the rest so grossly led

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: This juggling witchcraft with revenue cherish,

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Yet I alone, alone do me oppose

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Against the pope and count his friends my foes.

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: Then, by the lawful power that I have,

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: Thou shalt stand cursed and excommunicate.

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: And blessed shall he be that doth revolt

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: From his allegiance to an heretic;

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: And meritorious shall that hand be calld,

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: Canonized and worshipped as a saint,

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: That takes away by any secret course

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: Thy hateful life.

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: O, lawful let it be

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: That I have room with Rome to curse awhile!

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: Good father cardinal, cry thou amen

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: To my keen curses; for without my wrong

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: There is no tongue hath power to curse him right.

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: Theres law and warrant, lady, for my curse.

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: And for mine too: when law can do no right,

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: Let it be lawful that law bar no wrong:

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: Law cannot give my child his kingdom here,

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: For he that holds his kingdom holds the law;

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: Therefore, since law itself is perfect wrong,

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: How can the law forbid my tongue to curse?

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: Philip of France, on peril of a curse,

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: Let go the hand of that arch-heretic;

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: And raise the power of France upon his head,

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: Unless he do submit himself to Rome.

speaker: QUEEN ELINOR
text_entry: Lookst thou pale, France? do not let go thy hand.

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: Look to that, devil; lest that France repent,

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: And by disjoining hands, hell lose a soul.

speaker: AUSTRIA
text_entry: King Philip, listen to the cardinal.

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: And hang a calfs-skin on his recreant limbs.

speaker: AUSTRIA
text_entry: Well, ruffian, I must pocket up these wrongs, Because--

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: Your breeches best may carry them.

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Philip, what sayst thou to the cardinal?

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: What should he say, but as the cardinal?

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: Bethink you, father; for the difference

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: Is purchase of a heavy curse from Rome,

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: Or the light loss of England for a friend:

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: Forego the easier.

speaker: BLANCH
text_entry: Thats the curse of Rome.

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: O Lewis, stand fast! the devil tempts thee here

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: In likeness of a new untrimmed bride.

speaker: BLANCH
text_entry: The Lady Constance speaks not from her faith,

speaker: BLANCH
text_entry: But from her need.

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: O, if thou grant my need,

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: Which only lives but by the death of faith,

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: That need must needs infer this principle,

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: That faith would live again by death of need.

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: O then, tread down my need, and faith mounts up;

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: Keep my need up, and faith is trodden down!

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: The king is moved, and answers not to this.

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: O, be removed from him, and answer well!

speaker: AUSTRIA
text_entry: Do so, King Philip; hang no more in doubt.

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: Hang nothing but a calfs-skin, most sweet lout.

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: I am perplexd, and know not what to say.

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: What canst thou say but will perplex thee more,

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: If thou stand excommunicate and cursed?

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: Good reverend father, make my person yours,

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: And tell me how you would bestow yourself.

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: This royal hand and mine are newly knit,

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: And the conjunction of our inward souls

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: Married in league, coupled and linked together

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: With all religious strength of sacred vows;

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: The latest breath that gave the sound of words

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: Was deep-sworn faith, peace, amity, true love

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: Between our kingdoms and our royal selves,

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: And even before this truce, but new before,

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: No longer than we well could wash our hands

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: To clap this royal bargain up of peace,

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: Heaven knows, they were besmeard and over-staind

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: With slaughters pencil, where revenge did paint

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: The fearful difference of incensed kings:

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: And shall these hands, so lately purged of blood,

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: So newly joind in love, so strong in both,

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: Unyoke this seizure and this kind regreet?

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: Play fast and loose with faith? so jest with heaven,

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: Make such unconstant children of ourselves,

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: As now again to snatch our palm from palm,

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: Unswear faith sworn, and on the marriage-bed

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: Of smiling peace to march a bloody host,

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: And make a riot on the gentle brow

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: Of true sincerity? O, holy sir,

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: My reverend father, let it not be so!

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: Out of your grace, devise, ordain, impose

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: Some gentle order; and then we shall be blest

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: To do your pleasure and continue friends.

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: All form is formless, order orderless,

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: Save what is opposite to Englands love.

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: Therefore to arms! be champion of our church,

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: Or let the church, our mother, breathe her curse,

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: A mothers curse, on her revolting son.

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: France, thou mayst hold a serpent by the tongue,

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: A chafed lion by the mortal paw,

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: A fasting tiger safer by the tooth,

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: Than keep in peace that hand which thou dost hold.

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: I may disjoin my hand, but not my faith.

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: So makest thou faith an enemy to faith;

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: And like a civil war setst oath to oath,

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: Thy tongue against thy tongue. O, let thy vow

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: First made to heaven, first be to heaven performd,

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: That is, to be the champion of our church!

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: What since thou sworest is sworn against thyself

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: And may not be performed by thyself,

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: For that which thou hast sworn to do amiss

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: Is not amiss when it is truly done,

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: And being not done, where doing tends to ill,

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: The truth is then most done not doing it:

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: The better act of purposes mistook

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: Is to mistake again; though indirect,

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: Yet indirection thereby grows direct,

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: And falsehood falsehood cures, as fire cools fire

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: Within the scorched veins of one new-burnd.

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: It is religion that doth make vows kept;

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: But thou hast sworn against religion,

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: By what thou swearst against the thing thou swearst,

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: And makest an oath the surety for thy truth

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: Against an oath: the truth thou art unsure

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: To swear, swears only not to be forsworn;

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: Else what a mockery should it be to swear!

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: But thou dost swear only to be forsworn;

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: And most forsworn, to keep what thou dost swear.

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: Therefore thy later vows against thy first

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: Is in thyself rebellion to thyself;

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: And better conquest never canst thou make

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: Than arm thy constant and thy nobler parts

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: Against these giddy loose suggestions:

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: Upon which better part our prayers come in,

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: If thou vouchsafe them. But if not, then know

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: The peril of our curses light on thee

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: So heavy as thou shalt not shake them off,

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: But in despair die under their black weight.

speaker: AUSTRIA
text_entry: Rebellion, flat rebellion!

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: Willt not be?

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: Will not a calfs-skin stop that mouth of thine?

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: Father, to arms!

speaker: BLANCH
text_entry: Upon thy wedding-day?

speaker: BLANCH
text_entry: Against the blood that thou hast married?

speaker: BLANCH
text_entry: What, shall our feast be kept with slaughterd men?

speaker: BLANCH
text_entry: Shall braying trumpets and loud churlish drums,

speaker: BLANCH
text_entry: Clamours of hell, be measures to our pomp?

speaker: BLANCH
text_entry: O husband, hear me! ay, alack, how new

speaker: BLANCH
text_entry: Is husband in my mouth! even for that name,

speaker: BLANCH
text_entry: Which till this time my tongue did neer pronounce,

speaker: BLANCH
text_entry: Upon my knee I beg, go not to arms

speaker: BLANCH
text_entry: Against mine uncle.

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: O, upon my knee,

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: Made hard with kneeling, I do pray to thee,

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: Thou virtuous Dauphin, alter not the doom

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: Forethought by heaven!

speaker: BLANCH
text_entry: Now shall I see thy love: what motive may

speaker: BLANCH
text_entry: Be stronger with thee than the name of wife?

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: That which upholdeth him that thee upholds,

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: His honour: O, thine honour, Lewis, thine honour!

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: I muse your majesty doth seem so cold,

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: When such profound respects do pull you on.

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: I will denounce a curse upon his head.

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: Thou shalt not need. England, I will fall from thee.

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: O fair return of banishd majesty!

speaker: QUEEN ELINOR
text_entry: O foul revolt of French inconstancy!

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: France, thou shalt rue this hour within this hour.

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: Old Time the clock-setter, that bald sexton Time,

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: Is it as he will? well then, France shall rue.

speaker: BLANCH
text_entry: The suns oercast with blood: fair day, adieu!

speaker: BLANCH
text_entry: Which is the side that I must go withal?

speaker: BLANCH
text_entry: I am with both: each army hath a hand;

speaker: BLANCH
text_entry: And in their rage, I having hold of both,

speaker: BLANCH
text_entry: They swirl asunder and dismember me.

speaker: BLANCH
text_entry: Husband, I cannot pray that thou mayst win;

speaker: BLANCH
text_entry: Uncle, I needs must pray that thou mayst lose;

speaker: BLANCH
text_entry: Father, I may not wish the fortune thine;

speaker: BLANCH
text_entry: Grandam, I will not wish thy fortunes thrive:

speaker: BLANCH
text_entry: Whoever wins, on that side shall I lose

speaker: BLANCH
text_entry: Assured loss before the match be playd.

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: Lady, with me, with me thy fortune lies.

speaker: BLANCH
text_entry: There where my fortune lives, there my life dies.

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Cousin, go draw our puissance together.

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Exit BASTARD

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: France, I am burnd up with inflaming wrath;

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: A rage whose heat hath this condition,

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: That nothing can allay, nothing but blood,

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: The blood, and dearest-valued blood, of France.

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: Thy rage sham burn thee up, and thou shalt turn

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: To ashes, ere our blood shall quench that fire:

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: Look to thyself, thou art in jeopardy.

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: No more than he that threats. To arms lets hie!

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Exeunt

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: SCENE II. The same. Plains near Angiers.

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Alarums, excursions. Enter the BASTARD, with AUSTRIAS head

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: Now, by my life, this day grows wondrous hot;

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: Some airy devil hovers in the sky

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: And pours down mischief. Austrias head lie there,

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: While Philip breathes.

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: Enter KING JOHN, ARTHUR, and HUBERT

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Hubert, keep this boy. Philip, make up:

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: My mother is assailed in our tent,

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: And taen, I fear.

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: My lord, I rescued her;

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: Her highness is in safety, fear you not:

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: But on, my liege; for very little pains

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: Will bring this labour to an happy end.

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: Exeunt

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: SCENE III. The same.

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: Alarums, excursions, retreat. Enter KING JOHN,  QUEEN ELINOR, ARTHUR, the BASTARD, HUBERT, and Lords

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: [To QUEEN ELINOR]  So shall it be; your grace shall

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: stay behind

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: So strongly guarded.

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: To ARTHUR

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Cousin, look not sad:

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Thy grandam loves thee; and thy uncle will

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: As dear be to thee as thy father was.

speaker: ARTHUR
text_entry: O, this will make my mother die with grief!

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: [To the BASTARD]  Cousin, away for England!

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: haste before:

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: And, ere our coming, see thou shake the bags

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Of hoarding abbots; imprisoned angels

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Set at liberty: the fat ribs of peace

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Must by the hungry now be fed upon:

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Use our commission in his utmost force.

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: Bell, book, and candle shall not drive me back,

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: When gold and silver becks me to come on.

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: I leave your highness. Grandam, I will pray,

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: If ever I remember to be holy,

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: For your fair safety; so, I kiss your hand.

speaker: ELINOR
text_entry: Farewell, gentle cousin.

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Coz, farewell.

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Exit the BASTARD

speaker: QUEEN ELINOR
text_entry: Come hither, little kinsman; hark, a word.

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Come hither, Hubert. O my gentle Hubert,

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: We owe thee much! within this wall of flesh

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: There is a soul counts thee her creditor

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: And with advantage means to pay thy love:

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: And my good friend, thy voluntary oath

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Lives in this bosom, dearly cherished.

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Give me thy hand. I had a thing to say,

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: But I will fit it with some better time.

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: By heaven, Hubert, I am almost ashamed

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: To say what good respect I have of thee.

speaker: HUBERT
text_entry: I am much bounden to your majesty.

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Good friend, thou hast no cause to say so yet,

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: But thou shalt have; and creep time neer so slow,

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Yet it shall come from me to do thee good.

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: I had a thing to say, but let it go:

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: The sun is in the heaven, and the proud day,

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Attended with the pleasures of the world,

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Is all too wanton and too full of gawds

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: To give me audience: if the midnight bell

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Did, with his iron tongue and brazen mouth,

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Sound on into the drowsy race of night;

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: If this same were a churchyard where we stand,

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: And thou possessed with a thousand wrongs,

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Or if that surly spirit, melancholy,

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Had baked thy blood and made it heavy-thick,

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Which else runs tickling up and down the veins,

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Making that idiot, laughter, keep mens eyes

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: And strain their cheeks to idle merriment,

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: A passion hateful to my purposes,

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Or if that thou couldst see me without eyes,

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Hear me without thine ears, and make reply

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Without a tongue, using conceit alone,

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Without eyes, ears and harmful sound of words;

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Then, in despite of brooded watchful day,

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: I would into thy bosom pour my thoughts:

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: But, ah, I will not! yet I love thee well;

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: And, by my troth, I think thou lovest me well.

speaker: HUBERT
text_entry: So well, that what you bid me undertake,

speaker: HUBERT
text_entry: Though that my death were adjunct to my act,

speaker: HUBERT
text_entry: By heaven, I would do it.

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Do not I know thou wouldst?

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Good Hubert, Hubert, Hubert, throw thine eye

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: On yon young boy: Ill tell thee what, my friend,

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: He is a very serpent in my way;

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: And wheresoer this foot of mine doth tread,

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: He lies before me: dost thou understand me?

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Thou art his keeper.

speaker: HUBERT
text_entry: And Ill keep him so,

speaker: HUBERT
text_entry: That he shall not offend your majesty.

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Death.

speaker: HUBERT
text_entry: My lord?

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: A grave.

speaker: HUBERT
text_entry: He shall not live.

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Enough.

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: I could be merry now. Hubert, I love thee;

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Well, Ill not say what I intend for thee:

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Remember. Madam, fare you well:

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Ill send those powers oer to your majesty.

speaker: ELINOR
text_entry: My blessing go with thee!

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: For England, cousin, go:

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Hubert shall be your man, attend on you

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: With all true duty. On toward Calais, ho!

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Exeunt

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: SCENE IV. The same. KING PHILIPS tent.

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Enter KING PHILIP, LEWIS, CARDINAL PANDULPH, and Attendants

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: So, by a roaring tempest on the flood,

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: A whole armado of convicted sail

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: Is scatterd and disjoind from fellowship.

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: Courage and comfort! all shall yet go well.

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: What can go well, when we have run so ill?

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: Are we not beaten? Is not Angiers lost?

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: Arthur taen prisoner? divers dear friends slain?

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: And bloody England into England gone,

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: Oerbearing interruption, spite of France?

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: What he hath won, that hath he fortified:

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: So hot a speed with such advice disposed,

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: Such temperate order in so fierce a cause,

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: Doth want example: who hath read or heard

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: Of any kindred action like to this?

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: Well could I bear that England had this praise,

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: So we could find some pattern of our shame.

text_entry: Enter CONSTANCE

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: Look, who comes here! a grave unto a soul;

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: Holding the eternal spirit against her will,

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: In the vile prison of afflicted breath.

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: I prithee, lady, go away with me.

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: Lo, now I now see the issue of your peace.

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: Patience, good lady! comfort, gentle Constance!

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: No, I defy all counsel, all redress,

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: But that which ends all counsel, true redress,

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: Death, death; O amiable lovely death!

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: Thou odouriferous stench! sound rottenness!

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: Arise forth from the couch of lasting night,

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: Thou hate and terror to prosperity,

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: And I will kiss thy detestable bones

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: And put my eyeballs in thy vaulty brows

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: And ring these fingers with thy household worms

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: And stop this gap of breath with fulsome dust

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: And be a carrion monster like thyself:

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: Come, grin on me, and I will think thou smilest

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: And buss thee as thy wife. Miserys love,

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: O, come to me!

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: O fair affliction, peace!

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: No, no, I will not, having breath to cry:

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: O, that my tongue were in the thunders mouth!

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: Then with a passion would I shake the world;

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: And rouse from sleep that fell anatomy

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: Which cannot hear a ladys feeble voice,

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: Which scorns a modern invocation.

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: Lady, you utter madness, and not sorrow.

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: Thou art not holy to belie me so;

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: I am not mad: this hair I tear is mine;

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: My name is Constance; I was Geffreys wife;

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: Young Arthur is my son, and he is lost:

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: I am not mad: I would to heaven I were!

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: For then, tis like I should forget myself:

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: O, if I could, what grief should I forget!

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: Preach some philosophy to make me mad,

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: And thou shalt be canonized, cardinal;

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: For being not mad but sensible of grief,

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: My reasonable part produces reason

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: How I may be deliverd of these woes,

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: And teaches me to kill or hang myself:

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: If I were mad, I should forget my son,

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: Or madly think a babe of clouts were he:

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: I am not mad; too well, too well I feel

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: The different plague of each calamity.

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: Bind up those tresses. O, what love I note

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: In the fair multitude of those her hairs!

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: Where but by chance a silver drop hath fallen,

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: Even to that drop ten thousand wiry friends

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: Do glue themselves in sociable grief,

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: Like true, inseparable, faithful loves,

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: Sticking together in calamity.

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: To England, if you will.

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: Bind up your hairs.

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: Yes, that I will; and wherefore will I do it?

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: I tore them from their bonds and cried aloud

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: O that these hands could so redeem my son,

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: As they have given these hairs their liberty!

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: But now I envy at their liberty,

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: And will again commit them to their bonds,

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: Because my poor child is a prisoner.

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: And, father cardinal, I have heard you say

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: That we shall see and know our friends in heaven:

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: If that be true, I shall see my boy again;

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: For since the birth of Cain, the first male child,

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: To him that did but yesterday suspire,

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: There was not such a gracious creature born.

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: But now will canker-sorrow eat my bud

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: And chase the native beauty from his cheek

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: And he will look as hollow as a ghost,

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: As dim and meagre as an agues fit,

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: And so hell die; and, rising so again,

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: When I shall meet him in the court of heaven

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: I shall not know him: therefore never, never

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: Must I behold my pretty Arthur more.

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: You hold too heinous a respect of grief.

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: He talks to me that never had a son.

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: You are as fond of grief as of your child.

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: Grief fills the room up of my absent child,

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: Lies in his bed, walks up and down with me,

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: Puts on his pretty looks, repeats his words,

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: Remembers me of all his gracious parts,

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: Stuffs out his vacant garments with his form;

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: Then, have I reason to be fond of grief?

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: Fare you well: had you such a loss as I,

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: I could give better comfort than you do.

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: I will not keep this form upon my head,

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: When there is such disorder in my wit.

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: O Lord! my boy, my Arthur, my fair son!

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: My life, my joy, my food, my all the world!

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: My widow-comfort, and my sorrows cure!

speaker: CONSTANCE
text_entry: Exit

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: I fear some outrage, and Ill follow her.

speaker: KING PHILIP
text_entry: Exit

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: Theres nothing in this world can make me joy:

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: Life is as tedious as a twice-told tale

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: Vexing the dull ear of a drowsy man;

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: And bitter shame hath spoild the sweet worlds taste

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: That it yields nought but shame and bitterness.

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: Before the curing of a strong disease,

text_entry: Even in the instant of repair and health,

text_entry: The fit is strongest; evils that take leave,

text_entry: All days of glory, joy and happiness.

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: If you had won it, certainly you had.

text_entry: No, no; when Fortune means to men most good,

text_entry: She looks upon them with a threatening eye.

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: In this which he accounts so clearly won:

text_entry: Are not you grieved that Arthur is his prisoner?

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: As heartily as he is glad he hath him.

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: Your mind is all as youthful as your blood.

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: Now hear me speak with a prophetic spirit;

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: For even the breath of what I mean to speak

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: Shall blow each dust, each straw, each little rub,

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: Out of the path which shall directly lead

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: Thy foot to Englands throne; and therefore mark.

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: John hath seized Arthur; and it cannot be

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: That, whiles warm life plays in that infants veins,

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: The misplaced John should entertain an hour,

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: One minute, nay, one quiet breath of rest.

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: A sceptre snatchd with an unruly hand

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: Must be as boisterously maintaind as gaind;

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: And he that stands upon a slippery place

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: Makes nice of no vile hold to stay him up:

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: That John may stand, then Arthur needs must fall;

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: So be it, for it cannot be but so.

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: But what shall I gain by young Arthurs fall?

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: You, in the right of Lady Blanch your wife,

text_entry: May then make all the claim that Arthur did.

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: And lose it, life and all, as Arthur did.

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: How green you are and fresh in this old world!

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: John lays you plots; the times conspire with you;

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: For he that steeps his safety in true blood

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: Shall find but bloody safety and untrue.

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: This act so evilly born shall cool the hearts

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: Of all his people and freeze up their zeal,

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: That none so small advantage shall step forth

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: To cheque his reign, but they will cherish it;

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: No natural exhalation in the sky,

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: No scope of nature, no distemperd day,

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: No common wind, no customed event,

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: But they will pluck away his natural cause

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: And call them meteors, prodigies and signs,

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: Abortives, presages and tongues of heaven,

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: Plainly denouncing vengeance upon John.

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: May be he will not touch young Arthurs life,

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: But hold himself safe in his prisonment.

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: O, sir, when he shall hear of your approach,

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: If that young Arthur be not gone already,

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: Even at that news he dies; and then the hearts

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: Of all his people shall revolt from him

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: And kiss the lips of unacquainted change

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: And pick strong matter of revolt and wrath

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: Out of the bloody fingers ends of John.

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: Methinks I see this hurly all on foot:

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: And, O, what better matter breeds for you

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: Than I have named! The bastard Faulconbridge

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: Is now in England, ransacking the church,

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: Offending charity: if but a dozen French

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: Were there in arms, they would be as a call

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: To train ten thousand English to their side,

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: Or as a little snow, tumbled about,

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: Anon becomes a mountain. O noble Dauphin,

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: Go with me to the king: tis wonderful

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: What may be wrought out of their discontent,

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: Now that their souls are topful of offence.

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: For England go: I will whet on the king.

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: Strong reasons make strong actions: let us go:

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: If you say ay, the king will not say no.

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: Outside or inside, I will not return

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: Till my attempt so much be glorified

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: As to my ample hope was promised

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: Before I drew this gallant head of war,

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: And culld these fiery spirits from the world,

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: To outlook conquest and to win renown

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: Even in the jaws of danger and of death.

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: Trumpet sounds

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: What lusty trumpet thus doth summon us?

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: Enter the BASTARD, attended

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: According to the fair play of the world,

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: Let me have audience; I am sent to speak:

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: My holy lord of Milan, from the king

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: I come, to learn how you have dealt for him;

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: And, as you answer, I do know the scope

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: And warrant limited unto my tongue.

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: The Dauphin is too wilful-opposite,

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: And will not temporize with my entreaties;

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: He flatly says hell not lay down his arms.

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: By all the blood that ever fury breathed,

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: The youth says well. Now hear our English king;

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: For thus his royalty doth speak in me.

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: He is prepared, and reason too he should:

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: This apish and unmannerly approach,

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: This harnessd masque and unadvised revel,

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: This unhaird sauciness and boyish troops,

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: The king doth smile at; and is well prepared

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: To whip this dwarfish war, these pigmy arms,

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: From out the circle of his territories.

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: That hand which had the strength, even at your door,

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: To cudgel you and make you take the hatch,

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: To dive like buckets in concealed wells,

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: To crouch in litter of your stable planks,

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: To lie like pawns lockd up in chests and trunks,

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: To hug with swine, to seek sweet safety out

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: In vaults and prisons, and to thrill and shake

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: Even at the crying of your nations crow,

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: Thinking his voice an armed Englishman;

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: Shall that victorious hand be feebled here,

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: That in your chambers gave you chastisement?

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: No: know the gallant monarch is in arms

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: And like an eagle oer his aery towers,

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: To souse annoyance that comes near his nest.

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: And you degenerate, you ingrate revolts,

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: You bloody Neroes, ripping up the womb

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: Of your dear mother England, blush for shame;

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: For your own ladies and pale-visaged maids

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: Like Amazons come tripping after drums,

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: Their thimbles into armed gauntlets change,

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: Their needles to lances, and their gentle hearts

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: To fierce and bloody inclination.

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: There end thy brave, and turn thy face in peace;

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: We grant thou canst outscold us: fare thee well;

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: We hold our time too precious to be spent

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: With such a brabbler.

speaker: CARDINAL PANDULPH
text_entry: Give me leave to speak.

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: No, I will speak.

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: We will attend to neither.

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: Strike up the drums; and let the tongue of war

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: Plead for our interest and our being here.

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: Indeed your drums, being beaten, will cry out;

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: And so shall you, being beaten: do but start

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: An echo with the clamour of thy drum,

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: And even at hand a drum is ready braced

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: That shall reverberate all as loud as thine;

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: Sound but another, and another shall

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: As loud as thine rattle the welkins ear

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: And mock the deep-mouthd thunder: for at hand,

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: Not trusting to this halting legate here,

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: Whom he hath used rather for sport than need

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: Is warlike John; and in his forehead sits

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: A bare-ribbd death, whose office is this day

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: To feast upon whole thousands of the French.

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: Strike up our drums, to find this danger out.

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: And thou shalt find it, Dauphin, do not doubt.

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: Exeunt

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: SCENE III. The field of battle.

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: Alarums. Enter KING JOHN and HUBERT

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: How goes the day with us? O, tell me, Hubert.

speaker: HUBERT
text_entry: Badly, I fear. How fares your majesty?

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: This fever, that hath troubled me so long,

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Lies heavy on me; O, my heart is sick!

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Enter a Messenger

speaker: Messenger
text_entry: My lord, your valiant kinsman, Faulconbridge,

speaker: Messenger
text_entry: Desires your majesty to leave the field

speaker: Messenger
text_entry: And send him word by me which way you go.

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Tell him, toward Swinstead, to the abbey there.

speaker: Messenger
text_entry: Be of good comfort; for the great supply

speaker: Messenger
text_entry: That was expected by the Dauphin here,

speaker: Messenger
text_entry: Are wreckd three nights ago on Goodwin Sands.

speaker: Messenger
text_entry: This news was brought to Richard but even now:

speaker: Messenger
text_entry: The French fight coldly, and retire themselves.

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Ay me! this tyrant fever burns me up,

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: And will not let me welcome this good news.

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Set on toward Swinstead: to my litter straight;

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Weakness possesseth me, and I am faint.

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Exeunt

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: SCENE IV. Another part of the field.

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Enter SALISBURY, PEMBROKE, and BIGOT

speaker: SALISBURY
text_entry: I did not think the king so stored with friends.

speaker: PEMBROKE
text_entry: Up once again; put spirit in the French:

speaker: PEMBROKE
text_entry: If they miscarry, we miscarry too.

speaker: SALISBURY
text_entry: That misbegotten devil, Faulconbridge,

speaker: SALISBURY
text_entry: In spite of spite, alone upholds the day.

speaker: PEMBROKE
text_entry: They say King John sore sick hath left the field.

speaker: PEMBROKE
text_entry: Enter MELUN, wounded

speaker: MELUN
text_entry: Lead me to the revolts of England here.

speaker: SALISBURY
text_entry: When we were happy we had other names.

speaker: PEMBROKE
text_entry: It is the Count Melun.

speaker: SALISBURY
text_entry: Wounded to death.

speaker: MELUN
text_entry: Fly, noble English, you are bought and sold;

speaker: MELUN
text_entry: Unthread the rude eye of rebellion

speaker: MELUN
text_entry: And welcome home again discarded faith.

speaker: MELUN
text_entry: Seek out King John and fall before his feet;

speaker: MELUN
text_entry: For if the French be lords of this loud day,

speaker: MELUN
text_entry: He means to recompense the pains you take

speaker: MELUN
text_entry: By cutting off your heads: thus hath he sworn

speaker: MELUN
text_entry: And I with him, and many moe with me,

speaker: MELUN
text_entry: Upon the altar at Saint Edmundsbury;

speaker: MELUN
text_entry: Even on that altar where we swore to you

speaker: MELUN
text_entry: Dear amity and everlasting love.

speaker: SALISBURY
text_entry: May this be possible? may this be true?

speaker: MELUN
text_entry: Have I not hideous death within my view,

speaker: MELUN
text_entry: Retaining but a quantity of life,

speaker: MELUN
text_entry: Which bleeds away, even as a form of wax

speaker: MELUN
text_entry: Resolveth from his figure gainst the fire?

speaker: MELUN
text_entry: What in the world should make me now deceive,

speaker: MELUN
text_entry: Since I must lose the use of all deceit?

speaker: MELUN
text_entry: Why should I then be false, since it is true

speaker: MELUN
text_entry: That I must die here and live hence by truth?

speaker: MELUN
text_entry: I say again, if Lewis do win the day,

speaker: MELUN
text_entry: He is forsworn, if eer those eyes of yours

speaker: MELUN
text_entry: Behold another day break in the east:

speaker: MELUN
text_entry: But even this night, whose black contagious breath

speaker: MELUN
text_entry: Already smokes about the burning crest

speaker: MELUN
text_entry: Of the old, feeble and day-wearied sun,

speaker: MELUN
text_entry: Even this ill night, your breathing shall expire,

speaker: MELUN
text_entry: Paying the fine of rated treachery

speaker: MELUN
text_entry: Even with a treacherous fine of all your lives,

speaker: MELUN
text_entry: If Lewis by your assistance win the day.

speaker: MELUN
text_entry: Commend me to one Hubert with your king:

speaker: MELUN
text_entry: The love of him, and this respect besides,

speaker: MELUN
text_entry: For that my grandsire was an Englishman,

speaker: MELUN
text_entry: Awakes my conscience to confess all this.

speaker: MELUN
text_entry: In lieu whereof, I pray you, bear me hence

speaker: MELUN
text_entry: From forth the noise and rumour of the field,

speaker: MELUN
text_entry: Where I may think the remnant of my thoughts

speaker: MELUN
text_entry: In peace, and part this body and my soul

speaker: MELUN
text_entry: With contemplation and devout desires.

speaker: SALISBURY
text_entry: We do believe thee: and beshrew my soul

speaker: SALISBURY
text_entry: But I do love the favour and the form

speaker: SALISBURY
text_entry: Of this most fair occasion, by the which

speaker: SALISBURY
text_entry: We will untread the steps of damned flight,

speaker: SALISBURY
text_entry: And like a bated and retired flood,

speaker: SALISBURY
text_entry: Leaving our rankness and irregular course,

speaker: SALISBURY
text_entry: Stoop low within those bounds we have oerlookd

speaker: SALISBURY
text_entry: And cabby run on in obedience

speaker: SALISBURY
text_entry: Even to our ocean, to our great King John.

speaker: SALISBURY
text_entry: My arm shall give thee help to bear thee hence;

speaker: SALISBURY
text_entry: For I do see the cruel pangs of death

speaker: SALISBURY
text_entry: Right in thine eye. Away, my friends! New flight;

speaker: SALISBURY
text_entry: And happy newness, that intends old right.

speaker: SALISBURY
text_entry: Exeunt, leading off MELUN

speaker: SALISBURY
text_entry: SCENE V. The French camp.

speaker: SALISBURY
text_entry: Enter LEWIS and his train

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: The sun of heaven methought was loath to set,

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: But stayd and made the western welkin blush,

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: When English measure backward their own ground

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: In faint retire. O, bravely came we off,

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: When with a volley of our needless shot,

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: After such bloody toil, we bid good night;

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: And wound our tattering colours clearly up,

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: Last in the field, and almost lords of it!

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: Enter a Messenger

speaker: Messenger
text_entry: Where is my prince, the Dauphin?

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: Here: what news?

speaker: Messenger
text_entry: The Count Melun is slain; the English lords

speaker: Messenger
text_entry: By his persuasion are again falln off,

speaker: Messenger
text_entry: And your supply, which you have wishd so long,

speaker: Messenger
text_entry: Are cast away and sunk on Goodwin Sands.

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: Ah, foul shrewd news! beshrew thy very heart!

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: I did not think to be so sad to-night

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: As this hath made me. Who was he that said

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: King John did fly an hour or two before

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: The stumbling night did part our weary powers?

speaker: Messenger
text_entry: Whoever spoke it, it is true, my lord.

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: Well; keep good quarter and good care to-night:

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: The day shall not be up so soon as I,

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: To try the fair adventure of to-morrow.

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: Exeunt

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: SCENE VI. An open place in the neighbourhood of Swinstead Abbey.

speaker: LEWIS
text_entry: Enter the BASTARD and HUBERT, severally

speaker: HUBERT
text_entry: Whos there? speak, ho! speak quickly, or I shoot.

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: A friend. What art thou?

speaker: HUBERT
text_entry: Of the part of England.

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: Whither dost thou go?

speaker: HUBERT
text_entry: Whats that to thee? why may not I demand

speaker: HUBERT
text_entry: Of thine affairs, as well as thou of mine?

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: Hubert, I think?

speaker: HUBERT
text_entry: Thou hast a perfect thought:

speaker: HUBERT
text_entry: I will upon all hazards well believe

speaker: HUBERT
text_entry: Thou art my friend, that knowst my tongue so well.

speaker: HUBERT
text_entry: Who art thou?

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: Who thou wilt: and if thou please,

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: Thou mayst befriend me so much as to think

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: I come one way of the Plantagenets.

speaker: HUBERT
text_entry: Unkind remembrance! thou and eyeless night

speaker: HUBERT
text_entry: Have done me shame: brave soldier, pardon me,

speaker: HUBERT
text_entry: That any accent breaking from thy tongue

speaker: HUBERT
text_entry: Should scape the true acquaintance of mine ear.

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: Come, come; sans compliment, what news abroad?

speaker: HUBERT
text_entry: Why, here walk I in the black brow of night,

speaker: HUBERT
text_entry: To find you out.

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: Brief, then; and whats the news?

speaker: HUBERT
text_entry: O, my sweet sir, news fitting to the night,

speaker: HUBERT
text_entry: Black, fearful, comfortless and horrible.

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: Show me the very wound of this ill news:

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: I am no woman, Ill not swoon at it.

speaker: HUBERT
text_entry: The king, I fear, is poisond by a monk:

speaker: HUBERT
text_entry: I left him almost speechless; and broke out

speaker: HUBERT
text_entry: To acquaint you with this evil, that you might

speaker: HUBERT
text_entry: The better arm you to the sudden time,

speaker: HUBERT
text_entry: Than if you had at leisure known of this.

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: How did he take it? who did taste to him?

speaker: HUBERT
text_entry: A monk, I tell you; a resolved villain,

speaker: HUBERT
text_entry: Whose bowels suddenly burst out: the king

speaker: HUBERT
text_entry: Yet speaks and peradventure may recover.

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: Who didst thou leave to tend his majesty?

speaker: HUBERT
text_entry: Why, know you not? the lords are all come back,

speaker: HUBERT
text_entry: And brought Prince Henry in their company;

speaker: HUBERT
text_entry: At whose request the king hath pardond them,

speaker: HUBERT
text_entry: And they are all about his majesty.

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: Withhold thine indignation, mighty heaven,

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: And tempt us not to bear above our power!

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: Ill tell tree, Hubert, half my power this night,

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: Passing these flats, are taken by the tide;

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: These Lincoln Washes have devoured them;

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: Myself, well mounted, hardly have escaped.

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: Away before: conduct me to the king;

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: I doubt he will be dead or ere I come.

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: Exeunt

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: SCENE VII. The orchard in Swinstead Abbey.

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: Enter PRINCE HENRY, SALISBURY, and BIGOT

speaker: PRINCE HENRY
text_entry: It is too late: the life of all his blood

speaker: PRINCE HENRY
text_entry: Is touchd corruptibly, and his pure brain,

speaker: PRINCE HENRY
text_entry: Which some suppose the souls frail dwelling-house,

speaker: PRINCE HENRY
text_entry: Doth by the idle comments that it makes

speaker: PRINCE HENRY
text_entry: Foretell the ending of mortality.

speaker: PRINCE HENRY
text_entry: Enter PEMBROKE

speaker: PEMBROKE
text_entry: His highness yet doth speak, and holds belief

speaker: PEMBROKE
text_entry: That, being brought into the open air,

speaker: PEMBROKE
text_entry: It would allay the burning quality

speaker: PEMBROKE
text_entry: Of that fell poison which assaileth him.

speaker: PRINCE HENRY
text_entry: Let him be brought into the orchard here.

speaker: PRINCE HENRY
text_entry: Doth he still rage?

speaker: PRINCE HENRY
text_entry: Exit BIGOT

speaker: PEMBROKE
text_entry: He is more patient

speaker: PEMBROKE
text_entry: Than when you left him; even now he sung.

speaker: PRINCE HENRY
text_entry: O vanity of sickness! fierce extremes

speaker: PRINCE HENRY
text_entry: In their continuance will not feel themselves.

speaker: PRINCE HENRY
text_entry: Death, having preyd upon the outward parts,

speaker: PRINCE HENRY
text_entry: Leaves them invisible, and his siege is now

speaker: PRINCE HENRY
text_entry: Against the mind, the which he pricks and wounds

speaker: PRINCE HENRY
text_entry: With many legions of strange fantasies,

speaker: PRINCE HENRY
text_entry: Whi ch, in their throng and press to that last hold,

speaker: PRINCE HENRY
text_entry: Confound themselves. Tis strange that death

speaker: PRINCE HENRY
text_entry: should sing.

speaker: PRINCE HENRY
text_entry: I am the cygnet to this pale faint swan,

speaker: PRINCE HENRY
text_entry: Who chants a doleful hymn to his own death,

speaker: PRINCE HENRY
text_entry: And from the organ-pipe of frailty sings

speaker: PRINCE HENRY
text_entry: His soul and body to their lasting rest.

speaker: SALISBURY
text_entry: Be of good comfort, prince; for you are born

speaker: SALISBURY
text_entry: To set a form upon that indigest

speaker: SALISBURY
text_entry: Which he hath left so shapeless and so rude.

speaker: SALISBURY
text_entry: Enter Attendants, and BIGOT, carrying KING JOHN in a chair

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Ay, marry, now my soul hath elbow-room;

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: It would not out at windows nor at doors.

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: There is so hot a summer in my bosom,

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: That all my bowels crumble up to dust:

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: I am a scribbled form, drawn with a pen

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Upon a parchment, and against this fire

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Do I shrink up.

speaker: PRINCE HENRY
text_entry: How fares your majesty?

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Poisond,--ill fare--dead, forsook, cast off:

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: And none of you will bid the winter come

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: To thrust his icy fingers in my maw,

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Nor let my kingdoms rivers take their course

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Through my burnd bosom, nor entreat the north

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: To make his bleak winds kiss my parched lips

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: And comfort me with cold. I do not ask you much,

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: I beg cold comfort; and you are so strait

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: And so ingrateful, you deny me that.

speaker: PRINCE HENRY
text_entry: O that there were some virtue in my tears,

speaker: PRINCE HENRY
text_entry: That might relieve you!

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: The salt in them is hot.

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Within me is a hell; and there the poison

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Is as a fiend confined to tyrannize

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: On unreprievable condemned blood.

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Enter the BASTARD

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: O, I am scalded with my violent motion,

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: And spleen of speed to see your majesty!

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: O cousin, thou art come to set mine eye:

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: The tackle of my heart is crackd and burnd,

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: And all the shrouds wherewith my life should sail

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Are turned to one thread, one little hair:

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: My heart hath one poor string to stay it by,

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: Which holds but till thy news be uttered;

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: And then all this thou seest is but a clod

speaker: KING JOHN
text_entry: And module of confounded royalty.

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: The Dauphin is preparing hitherward,

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: Where heaven He knows how we shall answer him;

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: For in a night the best part of my power,

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: As I upon advantage did remove,

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: Were in the Washes all unwarily

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: Devoured by the unexpected flood.

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: KING JOHN dies

speaker: SALISBURY
text_entry: You breathe these dead news in as dead an ear.

speaker: SALISBURY
text_entry: My liege! my lord! but now a king, now thus.

speaker: PRINCE HENRY
text_entry: Even so must I run on, and even so stop.

speaker: PRINCE HENRY
text_entry: What surety of the world, what hope, what stay,

speaker: PRINCE HENRY
text_entry: When this was now a king, and now is clay?

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: Art thou gone so? I do but stay behind

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: To do the office for thee of revenge,

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: And then my soul shall wait on thee to heaven,

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: As it on earth hath been thy servant still.

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: Now, now, you stars that move in your right spheres,

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: Where be your powers? show now your mended faiths,

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: And instantly return with me again,

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: To push destruction and perpetual shame

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: Out of the weak door of our fainting land.

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: Straight let us seek, or straight we shall be sought;

speaker: BASTARD
text_entry: The Dauphin rages at our very heels.

speaker: SALISBURY
text_entry: It seems you know not, then, so much as we:

speaker: SALISBURY
text_entry: The Cardinal Pandulph is within at rest,

speaker: SALISBURY
text_entry: Who half an hour since came from the Dauphin,

speaker: SALISBURY
text_entry: And brings from him such offers of our peace
