text_entry: It is a mans voice. Gentle Isabella,

speaker: FRANCISCA
text_entry: Turn you the key, and know his business of him;

speaker: FRANCISCA
text_entry: You may, I may not; you are yet unsworn.

speaker: FRANCISCA
text_entry: When you have vowd, you must not speak with men

speaker: FRANCISCA
text_entry: But in the presence of the prioress:

speaker: FRANCISCA
text_entry: Then, if you speak, you must not show your face,

speaker: FRANCISCA
text_entry: Or, if you show your face, you must not speak.

speaker: FRANCISCA
text_entry: He calls again; I pray you, answer him.

speaker: FRANCISCA
text_entry: Exit

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: Peace and prosperity! Who ist that calls

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: Enter LUCIO

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: Hail, virgin, if you be, as those cheek-roses

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: Proclaim you are no less! Can you so stead me

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: As bring me to the sight of Isabella,

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: A novice of this place and the fair sister

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: To her unhappy brother Claudio?

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: Why her unhappy brother? let me ask,

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: The rather for I now must make you know

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: I am that Isabella and his sister.

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: Gentle and fair, your brother kindly greets you:

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: Not to be weary with you, hes in prison.

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: Woe me! for what?

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: For that which, if myself might be his judge,

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: He should receive his punishment in thanks:

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: He hath got his friend with child.

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: Sir, make me not your story.

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: It is true.

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: I would not--though tis my familiar sin

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: With maids to seem the lapwing and to jest,

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: Tongue far from heart--play with all virgins so:

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: I hold you as a thing enskyd and sainted.

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: By your renouncement an immortal spirit,

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: And to be talkd with in sincerity,

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: As with a saint.

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: You do blaspheme the good in mocking me.

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: Do not believe it. Fewness and truth, tis thus:

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: Your brother and his lover have embraced:

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: As those that feed grow full, as blossoming time

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: That from the seedness the bare fallow brings

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: To teeming foison, even so her plenteous womb

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: Expresseth his full tilth and husbandry.

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: Some one with child by him? My cousin Juliet?

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: Is she your cousin?

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: Adoptedly; as school-maids change their names

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: By vain though apt affection.

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: She it is.

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: O, let him marry her.

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: This is the point.

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: The duke is very strangely gone from hence;

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: Bore many gentlemen, myself being one,

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: In hand and hope of action: but we do learn

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: By those that know the very nerves of state,

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: His givings-out were of an infinite distance

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: From his true-meant design. Upon his place,

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: And with full line of his authority,

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: Governs Lord Angelo; a man whose blood

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: Is very snow-broth; one who never feels

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: The wanton stings and motions of the sense,

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: But doth rebate and blunt his natural edge

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: With profits of the mind, study and fast.

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: He--to give fear to use and liberty,

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: Which have for long run by the hideous law,

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: As mice by lions--hath pickd out an act,

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: Under whose heavy sense your brothers life

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: Falls into forfeit: he arrests him on it;

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: And follows close the rigour of the statute,

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: To make him an example. All hope is gone,

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: Unless you have the grace by your fair prayer

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: To soften Angelo: and thats my pith of business

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: Twixt you and your poor brother.

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: Doth he so seek his life?

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: Has censured him

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: Already; and, as I hear, the provost hath

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: A warrant for his execution.

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: Alas! what poor abilitys in me

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: To do him good?

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: Assay the power you have.

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: My power? Alas, I doubt--

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: Our doubts are traitors

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: And make us lose the good we oft might win

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: By fearing to attempt. Go to Lord Angelo,

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: And let him learn to know, when maidens sue,

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: Men give like gods; but when they weep and kneel,

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: All their petitions are as freely theirs

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: As they themselves would owe them.

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: Ill see what I can do.

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: But speedily.

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: I will about it straight;

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: No longer staying but to give the mother

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: Notice of my affair. I humbly thank you:

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: Commend me to my brother: soon at night

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: Ill send him certain word of my success.

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: I take my leave of you.

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: Good sir, adieu.

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: Exeunt

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: ACT II

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: SCENE I. A hall In ANGELOs house.

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: Enter ANGELO, ESCALUS, and a Justice, Provost, Officers, and other Attendants, behind

speaker: ANGELO
text_entry: We must not make a scarecrow of the law,

speaker: ANGELO
text_entry: Setting it up to fear the birds of prey,

speaker: ANGELO
text_entry: And let it keep one shape, till custom make it

speaker: ANGELO
text_entry: Their perch and not their terror.

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: Ay, but yet

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: Let us be keen, and rather cut a little,

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: Than fall, and bruise to death. Alas, this gentleman

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: Whom I would save, had a most noble father!

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: Let but your honour know,

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: Whom I believe to be most strait in virtue,

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: That, in the working of your own affections,

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: Had time cohered with place or place with wishing,

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: Or that the resolute acting of your blood

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: Could have attaind the effect of your own purpose,

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: Whether you had not sometime in your life

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: Errd in this point which now you censure him,

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: And pulld the law upon you.

speaker: ANGELO
text_entry: Tis one thing to be tempted, Escalus,

speaker: ANGELO
text_entry: Another thing to fall. I not deny,

speaker: ANGELO
text_entry: The jury, passing on the prisoners life,

speaker: ANGELO
text_entry: May in the sworn twelve have a thief or two

speaker: ANGELO
text_entry: Guiltier than him they try. Whats open made to justice,

speaker: ANGELO
text_entry: That justice seizes: what know the laws

speaker: ANGELO
text_entry: That thieves do pass on thieves? Tis very pregnant,

speaker: ANGELO
text_entry: The jewel that we find, we stoop and taket

speaker: ANGELO
text_entry: Because we see it; but what we do not see

speaker: ANGELO
text_entry: We tread upon, and never think of it.

speaker: ANGELO
text_entry: You may not so extenuate his offence

speaker: ANGELO
text_entry: For I have had such faults; but rather tell me,

speaker: ANGELO
text_entry: When I, that censure him, do so offend,

speaker: ANGELO
text_entry: Let mine own judgment pattern out my death,

speaker: ANGELO
text_entry: And nothing come in partial. Sir, he must die.

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: Be it as your wisdom will.

speaker: ANGELO
text_entry: Where is the provost?

speaker: Provost
text_entry: Here, if it like your honour.

speaker: ANGELO
text_entry: See that Claudio

speaker: ANGELO
text_entry: Be executed by nine to-morrow morning:

speaker: ANGELO
text_entry: Bring him his confessor, let him be prepared;

speaker: ANGELO
text_entry: For thats the utmost of his pilgrimage.

speaker: ANGELO
text_entry: Exit Provost

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: [Aside]  Well, heaven forgive him! and forgive us all!

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: Some rise by sin, and some by virtue fall:

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: Some run from brakes of ice, and answer none:

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: And some condemned for a fault alone.

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: Enter ELBOW, and Officers with FROTH and POMPEY

speaker: ELBOW
text_entry: Come, bring them away: if these be good people in

speaker: ELBOW
text_entry: a commonweal that do nothing but use their abuses in

speaker: ELBOW
text_entry: common houses, I know no law: bring them away.

speaker: ANGELO
text_entry: How now, sir! Whats your name? and whats the matter?

speaker: ELBOW
text_entry: If it Please your honour, I am the poor dukes

speaker: ELBOW
text_entry: constable, and my name is Elbow: I do lean upon

speaker: ELBOW
text_entry: justice, sir, and do bring in here before your good

speaker: ELBOW
text_entry: honour two notorious benefactors.

speaker: ANGELO
text_entry: Benefactors? Well; what benefactors are they? are

speaker: ANGELO
text_entry: they not malefactors?

speaker: ELBOW
text_entry: If it? please your honour, I know not well what they

speaker: ELBOW
text_entry: are: but precise villains they are, that I am sure

speaker: ELBOW
text_entry: of; and void of all profanation in the world that

speaker: ELBOW
text_entry: good Christians ought to have.

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: This comes off well; heres a wise officer.

speaker: ANGELO
text_entry: Go to: what quality are they of? Elbow is your

speaker: ANGELO
text_entry: name? why dost thou not speak, Elbow?

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: He cannot, sir; hes out at elbow.

speaker: ANGELO
text_entry: What are you, sir?

speaker: ELBOW
text_entry: He, sir! a tapster, sir; parcel-bawd; one that

speaker: ELBOW
text_entry: serves a bad woman; whose house, sir, was, as they

speaker: ELBOW
text_entry: say, plucked down in the suburbs; and now she

speaker: ELBOW
text_entry: professes a hot-house, which, I think, is a very ill house too.

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: How know you that?

speaker: ELBOW
text_entry: My wife, sir, whom I detest before heaven and your honour,--

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: How? thy wife?

speaker: ELBOW
text_entry: Ay, sir; whom, I thank heaven, is an honest woman,--

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: Dost thou detest her therefore?

speaker: ELBOW
text_entry: I say, sir, I will detest myself also, as well as

speaker: ELBOW
text_entry: she, that this house, if it be not a bawds house,

speaker: ELBOW
text_entry: it is pity of her life, for it is a naughty house.

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: How dost thou know that, constable?

speaker: ELBOW
text_entry: Marry, sir, by my wife; who, if she had been a woman

speaker: ELBOW
text_entry: cardinally given, might have been accused in

speaker: ELBOW
text_entry: fornication, adultery, and all uncleanliness there.

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: By the womans means?

speaker: ELBOW
text_entry: Ay, sir, by Mistress Overdones means: but as she

speaker: ELBOW
text_entry: spit in his face, so she defied him.

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: Sir, if it please your honour, this is not so.

speaker: ELBOW
text_entry: Prove it before these varlets here, thou honourable

speaker: ELBOW
text_entry: man; prove it.

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: Do you hear how he misplaces?

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: Sir, she came in great with child; and longing,

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: saving your honours reverence, for stewed prunes;

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: sir, we had but two in the house, which at that very

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: distant time stood, as it were, in a fruit-dish, a

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: dish of some three-pence; your honours have seen

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: such dishes; they are not China dishes, but very

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: good dishes,--

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: Go to, go to: no matter for the dish, sir.

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: No, indeed, sir, not of a pin; you are therein in

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: the right: but to the point. As I say, this

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: Mistress Elbow, being, as I say, with child, and

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: being great-bellied, and longing, as I said, for

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: prunes; and having but two in the dish, as I said,

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: Master Froth here, this very man, having eaten the

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: rest, as I said, and, as I say, paying for them very

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: honestly; for, as you know, Master Froth, I could

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: not give you three-pence again.

speaker: FROTH
text_entry: No, indeed.

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: Very well: you being then, if you be remembered,

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: cracking the stones of the foresaid prunes,--

speaker: FROTH
text_entry: Ay, so I did indeed.

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: Why, very well; I telling you then, if you be

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: remembered, that such a one and such a one were past

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: cure of the thing you wot of, unless they kept very

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: good diet, as I told you,--

speaker: FROTH
text_entry: All this is true.

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: Why, very well, then,--

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: Come, you are a tedious fool: to the purpose. What

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: was done to Elbows wife, that he hath cause to

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: complain of? Come me to what was done to her.

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: Sir, your honour cannot come to that yet.

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: No, sir, nor I mean it not.

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: Sir, but you shall come to it, by your honours

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: leave. And, I beseech you, look into Master Froth

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: here, sir; a man of four-score pound a year; whose

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: father died at Hallowmas: wast not at Hallowmas,

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: Master Froth?

speaker: FROTH
text_entry: All-hallond eve.

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: Why, very well; I hope here be truths. He, sir,

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: sitting, as I say, in a lower chair, sir; twas in

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: the Bunch of Grapes, where indeed you have a delight

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: to sit, have you not?

speaker: FROTH
text_entry: I have so; because it is an open room and good for winter.

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: Why, very well, then; I hope here be truths.

speaker: ANGELO
text_entry: This will last out a night in Russia,

speaker: ANGELO
text_entry: When nights are longest there: Ill take my leave.

speaker: ANGELO
text_entry: And leave you to the hearing of the cause;

speaker: ANGELO
text_entry: Hoping youll find good cause to whip them all.

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: I think no less. Good morrow to your lordship.

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: Exit ANGELO

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: Now, sir, come on: what was done to Elbows wife, once more?

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: Once, sir? there was nothing done to her once.

speaker: ELBOW
text_entry: I beseech you, sir, ask him what this man did to my wife.

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: I beseech your honour, ask me.

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: Well, sir; what did this gentleman to her?

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: I beseech you, sir, look in this gentlemans face.

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: Good Master Froth, look upon his honour; tis for a

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: good purpose. Doth your honour mark his face?

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: Ay, sir, very well.

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: Nay; I beseech you, mark it well.

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: Well, I do so.

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: Doth your honour see any harm in his face?

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: Why, no.

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: Ill be supposed upon a book, his face is the worst

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: thing about him. Good, then; if his face be the

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: worst thing about him, how could Master Froth do the

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: constables wife any harm? I would know that of

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: your honour.

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: Hes in the right. Constable, what say you to it?

speaker: ELBOW
text_entry: First, an it like you, the house is a respected

speaker: ELBOW
text_entry: house; next, this is a respected fellow; and his

speaker: ELBOW
text_entry: mistress is a respected woman.

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: By this hand, sir, his wife is a more respected

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: person than any of us all.

speaker: ELBOW
text_entry: Varlet, thou liest; thou liest, wicked varlet! the

speaker: ELBOW
text_entry: time has yet to come that she was ever respected

speaker: ELBOW
text_entry: with man, woman, or child.

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: Sir, she was respected with him before he married with her.

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: Which is the wiser here? Justice or Iniquity? Is

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: this true?

speaker: ELBOW
text_entry: O thou caitiff! O thou varlet! O thou wicked

speaker: ELBOW
text_entry: Hannibal! I respected with her before I was married

speaker: ELBOW
text_entry: to her! If ever I was respected with her, or she

speaker: ELBOW
text_entry: with me, let not your worship think me the poor

speaker: ELBOW
text_entry: dukes officer. Prove this, thou wicked Hannibal, or

speaker: ELBOW
text_entry: Ill have mine action of battery on thee.

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: If he took you a box o the ear, you might have your

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: action of slander too.

speaker: ELBOW
text_entry: Marry, I thank your good worship for it. What ist

speaker: ELBOW
text_entry: your worships pleasure I shall do with this wicked caitiff?

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: Truly, officer, because he hath some offences in him

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: that thou wouldst discover if thou couldst, let him

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: continue in his courses till thou knowest what they

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: are.

speaker: ELBOW
text_entry: Marry, I thank your worship for it. Thou seest, thou

speaker: ELBOW
text_entry: wicked varlet, now, whats come upon thee: thou art

speaker: ELBOW
text_entry: to continue now, thou varlet; thou art to continue.

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: Where were you born, friend?

speaker: FROTH
text_entry: Here in Vienna, sir.

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: Are you of fourscore pounds a year?

speaker: FROTH
text_entry: Yes, ant please you, sir.

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: So. What trade are you of, sir?

speaker: POMPHEY
text_entry: Tapster; a poor widows tapster.

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: Your mistress name?

speaker: POMPHEY
text_entry: Mistress Overdone.

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: Hath she had any more than one husband?

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: Nine, sir; Overdone by the last.

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: Nine! Come hither to me, Master Froth. Master

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: Froth, I would not have you acquainted with

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: tapsters: they will draw you, Master Froth, and you

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: will hang them. Get you gone, and let me hear no

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: more of you.

speaker: FROTH
text_entry: I thank your worship. For mine own part, I never

speaker: FROTH
text_entry: come into any room in a tap-house, but I am drawn

speaker: FROTH
text_entry: in.

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: Well, no more of it, Master Froth: farewell.

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: Exit FROTH

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: Come you hither to me, Master tapster. Whats your

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: name, Master tapster?

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: Pompey.

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: What else?

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: Bum, sir.

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: Troth, and your bum is the greatest thing about you;

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: so that in the beastliest sense you are Pompey the

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: Great. Pompey, you are partly a bawd, Pompey,

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: howsoever you colour it in being a tapster, are you

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: not? come, tell me true: it shall be the better for you.

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: Truly, sir, I am a poor fellow that would live.

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: How would you live, Pompey? by being a bawd? What

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: do you think of the trade, Pompey? is it a lawful trade?

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: If the law would allow it, sir.

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: But the law will not allow it, Pompey; nor it shall

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: not be allowed in Vienna.

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: Does your worship mean to geld and splay all the

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: youth of the city?

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: No, Pompey.

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: Truly, sir, in my poor opinion, they will tot then.

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: If your worship will take order for the drabs and

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: the knaves, you need not to fear the bawds.

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: There are pretty orders beginning, I can tell you:

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: it is but heading and hanging.

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: If you head and hang all that offend that way but

speaker: POMPEY

speaker: CLAUDIO
text_entry: Thou shalt not dot.

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: O, were it but my life,

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: Ild throw it down for your deliverance

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: As frankly as a pin.

speaker: CLAUDIO
text_entry: Thanks, dear Isabel.

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: Be ready, Claudio, for your death tomorrow.

speaker: CLAUDIO
text_entry: Yes. Has he affections in him,

speaker: CLAUDIO
text_entry: That thus can make him bite the law by the nose,

speaker: CLAUDIO
text_entry: When he would force it? Sure, it is no sin,

speaker: CLAUDIO
text_entry: Or of the deadly seven, it is the least.

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: Which is the least?

speaker: CLAUDIO
text_entry: If it were damnable, he being so wise,

speaker: CLAUDIO
text_entry: Why would he for the momentary trick

speaker: CLAUDIO
text_entry: Be perdurably fined? O Isabel!

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: What says my brother?

speaker: CLAUDIO
text_entry: Death is a fearful thing.

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: And shamed life a hateful.

speaker: CLAUDIO
text_entry: Ay, but to die, and go we know not where;

speaker: CLAUDIO
text_entry: To lie in cold obstruction and to rot;

speaker: CLAUDIO
text_entry: This sensible warm motion to become

speaker: CLAUDIO
text_entry: A kneaded clod; and the delighted spirit

speaker: CLAUDIO
text_entry: To bathe in fiery floods, or to reside

speaker: CLAUDIO
text_entry: In thrilling region of thick-ribbed ice;

speaker: CLAUDIO
text_entry: To be imprisond in the viewless winds,

speaker: CLAUDIO
text_entry: And blown with restless violence round about

speaker: CLAUDIO
text_entry: The pendent world; or to be worse than worst

speaker: CLAUDIO
text_entry: Of those that lawless and incertain thought

speaker: CLAUDIO
text_entry: Imagine howling: tis too horrible!

speaker: CLAUDIO
text_entry: The weariest and most loathed worldly life

speaker: CLAUDIO
text_entry: That age, ache, penury and imprisonment

speaker: CLAUDIO
text_entry: Can lay on nature is a paradise

speaker: CLAUDIO
text_entry: To what we fear of death.

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: Alas, alas!

speaker: CLAUDIO
text_entry: Sweet sister, let me live:

speaker: CLAUDIO
text_entry: What sin you do to save a brothers life,

speaker: CLAUDIO
text_entry: Nature dispenses with the deed so far

speaker: CLAUDIO
text_entry: That it becomes a virtue.

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: O you beast!

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: O faithless coward! O dishonest wretch!

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: Wilt thou be made a man out of my vice?

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: Ist not a kind of incest, to take life

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: From thine own sisters shame? What should I think?

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: Heaven shield my mother playd my father fair!

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: For such a warped slip of wilderness

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: Neer issued from his blood. Take my defiance!

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: Die, perish! Might but my bending down

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: Reprieve thee from thy fate, it should proceed:

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: Ill pray a thousand prayers for thy death,

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: No word to save thee.

speaker: CLAUDIO
text_entry: Nay, hear me, Isabel.

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: O, fie, fie, fie!

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: Thy sins not accidental, but a trade.

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: Mercy to thee would prove itself a bawd:

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: Tis best thou diest quickly.

speaker: CLAUDIO
text_entry: O hear me, Isabella!

speaker: CLAUDIO
text_entry: Re-enter DUKE VINCENTIO

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Vouchsafe a word, young sister, but one word.

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: What is your will?

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Might you dispense with your leisure, I would by and

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: by have some speech with you: the satisfaction I

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: would require is likewise your own benefit.

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: I have no superfluous leisure; my stay must be

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: stolen out of other affairs; but I will attend you awhile.

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: Walks apart

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Son, I have overheard what hath passed between you

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: and your sister. Angelo had never the purpose to

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: corrupt her; only he hath made an essay of her

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: virtue to practise his judgment with the disposition

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: of natures: she, having the truth of honour in her,

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: hath made him that gracious denial which he is most

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: glad to receive. I am confessor to Angelo, and I

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: know this to be true; therefore prepare yourself to

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: death: do not satisfy your resolution with hopes

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: that are fallible: tomorrow you must die; go to

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: your knees and make ready.

speaker: CLAUDIO
text_entry: Let me ask my sister pardon. I am so out of love

speaker: CLAUDIO
text_entry: with life that I will sue to be rid of it.

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Hold you there: farewell.

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Exit CLAUDIO

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Provost, a word with you!

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Re-enter Provost

speaker: Provost
text_entry: Whats your will, father

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: That now you are come, you will be gone. Leave me

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: awhile with the maid: my mind promises with my

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: habit no loss shall touch her by my company.

speaker: Provost
text_entry: In good time.

speaker: Provost
text_entry: Exit Provost. ISABELLA comes forward

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: The hand that hath made you fair hath made you good:

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: the goodness that is cheap in beauty makes beauty

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: brief in goodness; but grace, being the soul of

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: your complexion, shall keep the body of it ever

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: fair. The assault that Angelo hath made to you,

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: fortune hath conveyed to my understanding; and, but

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: that frailty hath examples for his falling, I should

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: wonder at Angelo. How will you do to content this

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: substitute, and to save your brother?

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: I am now going to resolve him: I had rather my

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: brother die by the law than my son should be

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: unlawfully born. But, O, how much is the good duke

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: deceived in Angelo! If ever he return and I can

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: speak to him, I will open my lips in vain, or

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: discover his government.

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: That shall not be much amiss: Yet, as the matter

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: now stands, he will avoid your accusation; he made

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: trial of you only. Therefore fasten your ear on my

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: advisings: to the love I have in doing good a

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: remedy presents itself. I do make myself believe

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: that you may most uprighteously do a poor wronged

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: lady a merited benefit; redeem your brother from

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: the angry law; do no stain to your own gracious

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: person; and much please the absent duke, if

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: peradventure he shall ever return to have hearing of

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: this business.

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: Let me hear you speak farther. I have spirit to do

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: anything that appears not foul in the truth of my spirit.

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Virtue is bold, and goodness never fearful. Have

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: you not heard speak of Mariana, the sister of

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Frederick the great soldier who miscarried at sea?

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: I have heard of the lady, and good words went with her name.

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: She should this Angelo have married; was affianced

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: to her by oath, and the nuptial appointed: between

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: which time of the contract and limit of the

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: solemnity, her brother Frederick was wrecked at sea,

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: having in that perished vessel the dowry of his

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: sister. But mark how heavily this befell to the

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: poor gentlewoman: there she lost a noble and

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: renowned brother, in his love toward her ever most

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: kind and natural; with him, the portion and sinew of

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: her fortune, her marriage-dowry; with both, her

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: combinate husband, this well-seeming Angelo.

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: Can this be so? did Angelo so leave her?

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Left her in her tears, and dried not one of them

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: with his comfort; swallowed his vows whole,

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: pretending in her discoveries of dishonour: in few,

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: bestowed her on her own lamentation, which she yet

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: wears for his sake; and he, a marble to her tears,

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: is washed with them, but relents not.

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: What a merit were it in death to take this poor maid

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: from the world! What corruption in this life, that

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: it will let this man live! But how out of this can she avail?

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: It is a rupture that you may easily heal: and the

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: cure of it not only saves your brother, but keeps

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: you from dishonour in doing it.

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: Show me how, good father.

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: This forenamed maid hath yet in her the continuance

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: of her first affection: his unjust unkindness, that

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: in all reason should have quenched her love, hath,

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: like an impediment in the current, made it more

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: violent and unruly. Go you to Angelo; answer his

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: requiring with a plausible obedience; agree with

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: his demands to the point; only refer yourself to

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: this advantage, first, that your stay with him may

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: not be long; that the time may have all shadow and

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: silence in it; and the place answer to convenience.

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: This being granted in course,--and now follows

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: all,--we shall advise this wronged maid to stead up

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: your appointment, go in your place; if the encounter

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: acknowledge itself hereafter, it may compel him to

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: her recompense: and here, by this, is your brother

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: saved, your honour untainted, the poor Mariana

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: advantaged, and the corrupt deputy scaled. The maid

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: will I frame and make fit for his attempt. If you

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: think well to carry this as you may, the doubleness

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: of the benefit defends the deceit from reproof.

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: What think you of it?

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: The image of it gives me content already; and I

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: trust it will grow to a most prosperous perfection.

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: It lies much in your holding up. Haste you speedily

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: to Angelo: if for this night he entreat you to his

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: bed, give him promise of satisfaction. I will

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: presently to Saint Lukes: there, at the moated

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: grange, resides this dejected Mariana. At that

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: place call upon me; and dispatch with Angelo, that

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: it may be quickly.

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: I thank you for this comfort. Fare you well, good father.

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: Exeunt severally

speaker: ISABELLA

text_entry: Nay, if there be no remedy for it, but that you will

speaker: ELBOW
text_entry: needs buy and sell men and women like beasts, we

text_entry: shall have all the world drink brown and white bastard.

text_entry: O heavens! what stuff is here

text_entry: Come your way, sir. Bless you, good father friar.

text_entry: And you, good brother father. What offence hath

text_entry: this man made you, sir?

text_entry: Marry, sir, he hath offended the law: and, sir, we

text_entry: take him to be a thief too, sir; for we have found

text_entry: sent to the deputy.

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Fie, sirrah! a bawd, a wicked bawd!

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: The evil that thou causest to be done,

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: That is thy means to live. Do thou but think

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: What tis to cram a maw or clothe a back

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: From such a filthy vice: say to thyself,

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: From their abominable and beastly touches

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: I drink, I eat, array myself, and live.

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Canst thou believe thy living is a life,

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: So stinkingly depending? Go mend, go mend.

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: Indeed, it does stink in some sort, sir; but yet,

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: sir, I would prove--

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Nay, if the devil have given thee proofs for sin,

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Thou wilt prove his. Take him to prison, officer:

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Correction and instruction must both work

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Ere this rude beast will profit.

speaker: ELBOW
text_entry: He must before the deputy, sir; he has given him

speaker: ELBOW
text_entry: warning: the deputy cannot abide a whoremaster: if

speaker: ELBOW
text_entry: he be a whoremonger, and comes before him, he were

speaker: ELBOW
text_entry: as good go a mile on his errand.

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: That we were all, as some would seem to be,

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: From our faults, as faults from seeming, free!

speaker: ELBOW
text_entry: His neck will come to your waist,--a cord, sir.

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: I spy comfort; I cry bail. Heres a gentleman and a

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: friend of mine.

speaker: POMPEY

text_entry: still, ha?

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: is herself in the tub.

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: Why, tis good; it is the right of it; it must be

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: an unshunned consequence; it must be so. Art going

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: to prison, Pompey?

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: Yes, faith, sir.

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: Why, tis not amiss, Pompey. Farewell: go, say I

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: sent thee thither. For debt, Pompey? or how?

speaker: ELBOW
text_entry: For being a bawd, for being a bawd.

speaker: LUCIO

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: due of a bawd, why, tis his right: bawd is he

speaker: LUCIO

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: Pompey: you will turn good husband now, Pompey; you

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: will keep the house.

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: I hope, sir, your good worship will be my bail.

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: No, indeed, will I not, Pompey; it is not the wear.

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: I will pray, Pompey, to increase your bondage: If

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: you take it not patiently, why, your mettle is the

speaker: LUCIO

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: And you.

text_entry: Does Bridget paint still, Pompey, ha?

speaker: ELBOW
text_entry: Come your ways, sir; come.

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: You will not bail me, then, sir?

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: Then, Pompey, nor now. What news abroad, friar?

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: what news?

speaker: ELBOW
text_entry: Come your ways, sir; come.

speaker: LUCIO

speaker: LUCIO

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: What news, friar, of the duke?

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: I know none. Can you tell me of any?

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: Some say he is with the Emperor of Russia; other

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: some, he is in Rome: but where is he, think you?

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: I know not where; but wheresoever, I wish him well.

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: It was a mad fantastical trick of him to steal from

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: the state, and usurp the beggary he was never born

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: to. Lord Angelo dukes it well in his absence; he

text_entry: puts transgression to t.

text_entry: He does well in t.

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: him: something too crabbed that way, friar.

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: Yes, in good sooth, the vice is of a great kindred;

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: it is well allied: but it is impossible to extirp

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: it quite, friar, till eating and drinking be put

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: down. They say this Angelo was not made by man and

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: woman after this downright way of creation: is it

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: true, think you?

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: How should he be made, then?

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: Some report a sea-maid spawned him; some, that he

text_entry: was begot between two stock-fishes. But it is

speaker: LUCIO

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: motion generative; thats infallible.

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: You are pleasant, sir, and speak apace.

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: Why, what a ruthless thing is this in him, for the

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: rebellion of a codpiece to take away the life of a

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: Ere he would have hanged a man for the getting a

speaker: LUCIO

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: a thousand: he had some feeling of the sport: he

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: knew the service, and that instructed him to mercy.

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: I never heard the absent duke much detected for

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: women; he was not inclined that way.

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: O, sir, you are deceived.

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Tis not possible.

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: Who, not the duke? yes, your beggar of fifty; and

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: his use was to put a ducat in her clack-dish: the

text_entry: duke had crotchets in him. He would be drunk too;

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: that let me inform you.

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: You do him wrong, surely.

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: Sir, I was an inward of his. A shy fellow was the

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: duke: and I believe I know the cause of his

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: withdrawing.

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: What, I prithee, might be the cause?

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: No, pardon; tis a secret must be locked within the

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: teeth and the lips: but this I can let you

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: understand, the greater file of the subject held the

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: duke to be wise.

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Wise! why, no question but he was.

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: A very superficial, ignorant, unweighing fellow.

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Either this is the envy in you, folly, or mistaking:

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: the very stream of his life and the business he hath

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: helmed must upon a warranted need give him a better

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: proclamation. Let him be but testimonied in his own

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: bringings-forth, and he shall appear to the

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: envious a scholar, a statesman and a soldier.

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Therefore you speak unskilfully: or if your

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: knowledge be more it is much darkened in your malice.

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: Sir, I know him, and I love him.

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Love talks with better knowledge, and knowledge with

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: dearer love.

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: Come, sir, I know what I know.

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: I can hardly believe that, since you know not what

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: you speak. But, if ever the duke return, as our

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: prayers are he may, let me desire you to make your

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: answer before him. If it be honest you have spoke,

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: you have courage to maintain it: I am bound to call

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: upon you; and, I pray you, your name?

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: Sir, my name is Lucio; well known to the duke.

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: He shall know you better, sir, if I may live to

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: report you.

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: I fear you not.

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: O, you hope the duke will return no more; or you

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: imagine me too unhurtful an opposite. But indeed I

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: can do you little harm; youll forswear this again.

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: Ill be hanged first: thou art deceived in me,

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: friar. But no more of this. Canst thou tell if

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: Claudio die to-morrow or no?

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Why should he die, sir?

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: Why? For filling a bottle with a tundish. I would

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: the duke we talk of were returned again: the

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: ungenitured agent will unpeople the province with

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: continency; sparrows must not build in his

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: house-eaves, because they are lecherous. The duke

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: yet would have dark deeds darkly answered; he would

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: never bring them to light: would he were returned!

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: Marry, this Claudio is condemned for untrussing.

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: Farewell, good friar: I prithee, pray for me. The

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: duke, I say to thee again, would eat mutton on

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: Fridays. Hes not past it yet, and I say to thee,

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: he would mouth with a beggar, though she smelt brown

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: bread and garlic: say that I said so. Farewell.

speaker: LUCIO
text_entry: Exit

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: No might nor greatness in mortality

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Can censure scape; back-wounding calumny

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: The whitest virtue strikes. What king so strong

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Can tie the gall up in the slanderous tongue?

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: But who comes here?

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Enter ESCALUS, Provost, and Officers with MISTRESS OVERDONE

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: Go; away with her to prison!

speaker: MISTRESS OVERDONE
text_entry: Good my lord, be good to me; your honour is accounted

speaker: MISTRESS OVERDONE
text_entry: a merciful man; good my lord.

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: Double and treble admonition, and still forfeit in

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: the same kind! This would make mercy swear and play

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: the tyrant.

speaker: Provost
text_entry: A bawd of eleven years continuance, may it please

speaker: Provost
text_entry: your honour.

speaker: MISTRESS OVERDONE
text_entry: My lord, this is one Lucios information against me.

speaker: MISTRESS OVERDONE
text_entry: Mistress Kate Keepdown was with child by him in the

speaker: MISTRESS OVERDONE
text_entry: dukes time; he promised her marriage: his child

speaker: MISTRESS OVERDONE
text_entry: is a year and a quarter old, come Philip and Jacob:

speaker: MISTRESS OVERDONE
text_entry: I have kept it myself; and see how he goes about to abuse me!

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: That fellow is a fellow of much licence: let him be

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: called before us. Away with her to prison! Go to;

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: no more words.

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: Exeunt Officers with MISTRESS OVERDONE

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: Provost, my brother Angelo will not be altered;

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: Claudio must die to-morrow: let him be furnished

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: with divines, and have all charitable preparation.

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: if my brother wrought by my pity, it should not be

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: so with him.

speaker: Provost
text_entry: So please you, this friar hath been with him, and

speaker: Provost
text_entry: advised him for the entertainment of death.

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: Good even, good father.

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Bliss and goodness on you!

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: Of whence are you?

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Not of this country, though my chance is now

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: To use it for my time: I am a brother

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Of gracious order, late come from the See

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: In special business from his holiness.

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: What news abroad i the world?

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: None, but that there is so great a fever on

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: goodness, that the dissolution of it must cure it:

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: novelty is only in request; and it is as dangerous

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: to be aged in any kind of course, as it is virtuous

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: to be constant in any undertaking. There is scarce

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: truth enough alive to make societies secure; but

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: security enough to make fellowships accurst: much

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: upon this riddle runs the wisdom of the world. This

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: news is old enough, yet it is every days news. I

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: pray you, sir, of what disposition was the duke?

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: One that, above all other strifes, contended

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: especially to know himself.

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: What pleasure was he given to?

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: Rather rejoicing to see another merry, than merry at

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: any thing which professed to make him rejoice: a

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: gentleman of all temperance. But leave we him to

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: his events, with a prayer they may prove prosperous;

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: and let me desire to know how you find Claudio

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: prepared. I am made to understand that you have

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: lent him visitation.

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: He professes to have received no sinister measure

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: from his judge, but most willingly humbles himself

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: to the determination of justice: yet had he framed

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: to himself, by the instruction of his frailty, many

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: deceiving promises of life; which I by my good

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: leisure have discredited to him, and now is he

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: resolved to die.

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: You have paid the heavens your function, and the

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: prisoner the very debt of your calling. I have

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: laboured for the poor gentleman to the extremest

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: shore of my modesty: but my brother justice have I

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: found so severe, that he hath forced me to tell him

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: he is indeed Justice.

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: If his own life answer the straitness of his

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: proceeding, it shall become him well; wherein if he

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: chance to fail, he hath sentenced himself.

speaker: ESCALUS
text_entry: I am going to visit the prisoner. Fare you well.

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Peace be with you!

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Exeunt ESCALUS and Provost

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: He who the sword of heaven will bear

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Should be as holy as severe;

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Pattern in himself to know,

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Grace to stand, and virtue go;

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: More nor less to others paying

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Than by self-offences weighing.

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Shame to him whose cruel striking

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Kills for faults of his own liking!

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Twice treble shame on Angelo,

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: To weed my vice and let his grow!

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: O, what may man within him hide,

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Though angel on the outward side!

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: How may likeness made in crimes,

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Making practise on the times,

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: To draw with idle spiders strings

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Most ponderous and substantial things!

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Craft against vice I must apply:

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: With Angelo to-night shall lie

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: His old betrothed but despised;

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: So disguise shall, by the disguised,

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Pay with falsehood false exacting,

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: And perform an old contracting.

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Exit

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: ACT IV

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: SCENE I. The moated grange at ST. LUKEs.

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Enter MARIANA and a Boy

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Boy sings

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Take, O, take those lips away,

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: That so sweetly were forsworn;

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: And those eyes, the break of day,

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Lights that do mislead the morn:

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: But my kisses bring again, bring again;

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Seals of love, but sealed in vain, sealed in vain.

speaker: MARIANA
text_entry: Break off thy song, and haste thee quick away:

speaker: MARIANA
text_entry: Here comes a man of comfort, whose advice

speaker: MARIANA
text_entry: Hath often stilld my brawling discontent.

speaker: MARIANA
text_entry: Exit Boy

speaker: MARIANA
text_entry: Enter DUKE VINCENTIO disguised as before

speaker: MARIANA
text_entry: I cry you mercy, sir; and well could wish

speaker: MARIANA
text_entry: You had not found me here so musical:

speaker: MARIANA
text_entry: Let me excuse me, and believe me so,

speaker: MARIANA
text_entry: My mirth it much displeased, but pleased my woe.

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Tis good; though music oft hath such a charm

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: To make bad good, and good provoke to harm.

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: I pray, you, tell me, hath any body inquired

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: for me here to-day? much upon this time have

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: I promised here to meet.

speaker: MARIANA
text_entry: You have not been inquired after:

speaker: MARIANA
text_entry: I have sat here all day.

speaker: MARIANA
text_entry: Enter ISABELLA

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: I do constantly believe you. The time is come even

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: now. I shall crave your forbearance a little: may

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: be I will call upon you anon, for some advantage to yourself.

speaker: MARIANA
text_entry: I am always bound to you.

speaker: MARIANA
text_entry: Exit

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Very well met, and well come.

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: What is the news from this good deputy?

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: He hath a garden circummured with brick,

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: Whose western side is with a vineyard backd;

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: And to that vineyard is a planched gate,

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: That makes his opening with this bigger key:

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: This other doth command a little door

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: Which from the vineyard to the garden leads;

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: There have I made my promise

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: Upon the heavy middle of the night

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: To call upon him.

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: But shall you on your knowledge find this way?

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: I have taen a due and wary note upont:

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: With whispering and most guilty diligence,

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: In action all of precept, he did show me

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: The way twice oer.

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Are there no other tokens

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Between you greed concerning her observance?

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: No, none, but only a repair i the dark;

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: And that I have possessd him my most stay

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: Can be but brief; for I have made him know

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: I have a servant comes with me along,

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: That stays upon me, whose persuasion is

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: I come about my brother.

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Tis well borne up.

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: I have not yet made known to Mariana

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: A word of this. What, ho! within! come forth!

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Re-enter MARIANA

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: I pray you, be acquainted with this maid;

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: She comes to do you good.

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: I do desire the like.

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Do you persuade yourself that I respect you?

speaker: MARIANA
text_entry: Good friar, I know you do, and have found it.

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Take, then, this your companion by the hand,

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Who hath a story ready for your ear.

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: I shall attend your leisure: but make haste;

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: The vaporous night approaches.

speaker: MARIANA
text_entry: Willt please you walk aside?

speaker: MARIANA
text_entry: Exeunt MARIANA and ISABELLA

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: O place and greatness! millions of false eyes

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Are stuck upon thee: volumes of report

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Run with these false and most contrarious quests

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Upon thy doings: thousand escapes of wit

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Make thee the father of their idle dreams

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: And rack thee in their fancies.

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Re-enter MARIANA and ISABELLA

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Welcome, how agreed?

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: Shell take the enterprise upon her, father,

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: If you advise it.

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: It is not my consent,

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: But my entreaty too.

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: Little have you to say

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: When you depart from him, but, soft and low,

speaker: ISABELLA
text_entry: Remember now my brother.

speaker: MARIANA
text_entry: Fear me not.

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Nor, gentle daughter, fear you not at all.

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: He is your husband on a pre-contract:

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: To bring you thus together, tis no sin,

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Sith that the justice of your title to him

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Doth flourish the deceit. Come, let us go:

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Our corns to reap, for yet our tithes to sow.

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Exeunt

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: SCENE II. A room in the prison.

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Enter Provost and POMPEY

speaker: Provost
text_entry: Come hither, sirrah. Can you cut off a mans head?

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: If the man be a bachelor, sir, I can; but if he be a

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: married man, hes his wifes head, and I can never

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: cut off a womans head.

speaker: Provost
text_entry: Come, sir, leave me your snatches, and yield me a

speaker: Provost
text_entry: direct answer. To-morrow morning are to die Claudio

speaker: Provost
text_entry: and Barnardine. Here is in our prison a common

speaker: Provost
text_entry: executioner, who in his office lacks a helper: if

speaker: Provost
text_entry: you will take it on you to assist him, it shall

speaker: Provost
text_entry: redeem you from your gyves; if not, you shall have

speaker: Provost
text_entry: your full time of imprisonment and your deliverance

speaker: Provost
text_entry: with an unpitied whipping, for you have been a

speaker: Provost
text_entry: notorious bawd.

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: Sir, I have been an unlawful bawd time out of mind;

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: but yet I will be content to be a lawful hangman. I

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: would be glad to receive some instruction from my

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: fellow partner.

speaker: Provost
text_entry: What, ho! Abhorson! Wheres Abhorson, there?

speaker: Provost
text_entry: Enter ABHORSON

speaker: ABHORSON
text_entry: Do you call, sir?

speaker: Provost
text_entry: Sirrah, heres a fellow will help you to-morrow in

speaker: Provost
text_entry: your execution. If you think it meet, compound with

speaker: Provost
text_entry: him by the year, and let him abide here with you; if

speaker: Provost
text_entry: not, use him for the present and dismiss him. He

speaker: Provost
text_entry: cannot plead his estimation with you; he hath been a bawd.

speaker: ABHORSON
text_entry: A bawd, sir? fie upon him! he will discredit our mystery.

speaker: Provost
text_entry: Go to, sir; you weigh equally; a feather will turn

speaker: Provost
text_entry: the scale.

speaker: Provost
text_entry: Exit

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: Pray, sir, by your good favour,--for surely, sir, a

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: good favour you have, but that you have a hanging

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: look,--do you call, sir, your occupation a mystery?

speaker: ABHORSON
text_entry: Ay, sir; a mystery

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: Painting, sir, I have heard say, is a mystery; and

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: your whores, sir, being members of my occupation,

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: using painting, do prove my occupation a mystery:

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: but what mystery there should be in hanging, if I

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: should be hanged, I cannot imagine.

speaker: ABHORSON
text_entry: Sir, it is a mystery.

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: Proof?

speaker: ABHORSON
text_entry: Every true mans apparel fits your thief: if it be

speaker: ABHORSON
text_entry: too little for your thief, your true man thinks it

speaker: ABHORSON
text_entry: big enough; if it be too big for your thief, your

speaker: ABHORSON
text_entry: thief thinks it little enough: so every true mans

speaker: ABHORSON
text_entry: apparel fits your thief.

speaker: ABHORSON
text_entry: Re-enter Provost

speaker: Provost
text_entry: Are you agreed?

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: Sir, I will serve him; for I do find your hangman is

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: a more penitent trade than your bawd; he doth

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: oftener ask forgiveness.

speaker: Provost
text_entry: You, sirrah, provide your block and your axe

speaker: Provost
text_entry: to-morrow four oclock.

speaker: ABHORSON
text_entry: Come on, bawd; I will instruct thee in my trade; follow.

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: I do desire to learn, sir: and I hope, if you have

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: occasion to use me for your own turn, you shall find

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: me yare; for truly, sir, for your kindness I owe you

speaker: POMPEY
text_entry: a good turn.

speaker: Provost
text_entry: Call hither Barnardine and Claudio:

speaker: Provost
text_entry: Exeunt POMPEY and ABHORSON

speaker: Provost
text_entry: The one has my pity; not a jot the other,

speaker: Provost
text_entry: Being a murderer, though he were my brother.

speaker: Provost
text_entry: Enter CLAUDIO

speaker: Provost
text_entry: Look, heres the warrant, Claudio, for thy death:

speaker: Provost
text_entry: Tis now dead midnight, and by eight to-morrow

speaker: Provost
text_entry: Thou must be made immortal. Wheres Barnardine?

speaker: CLAUDIO
text_entry: As fast lockd up in sleep as guiltless labour

speaker: CLAUDIO
text_entry: When it lies starkly in the travellers bones:

speaker: CLAUDIO
text_entry: He will not wake.

speaker: Provost
text_entry: Who can do good on him?

speaker: Provost
text_entry: Well, go, prepare yourself.

speaker: Provost
text_entry: Knocking within

speaker: Provost
text_entry: But, hark, what noise?

speaker: Provost
text_entry: Heaven give your spirits comfort!

speaker: Provost
text_entry: Exit CLAUDIO

speaker: Provost
text_entry: By and by.

speaker: Provost
text_entry: I hope it is some pardon or reprieve

speaker: Provost
text_entry: For the most gentle Claudio.

speaker: Provost
text_entry: Enter DUKE VINCENTIO disguised as before

speaker: Provost
text_entry: Welcome father.

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: The best and wholesomest spirts of the night

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Envelope you, good Provost! Who calld here of late?

speaker: Provost
text_entry: None, since the curfew rung.

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO

text_entry: SCENE I. Venice. A street.

speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO
text_entry: Enter ANTONIO, SALARINO, and SALANIO

speaker: ANTONIO
text_entry: In sooth, I know not why I am so sad:

speaker: ANTONIO
text_entry: It wearies me; you say it wearies you;

speaker: ANTONIO
text_entry: But how I caught it, found it, or came by it,

speaker: ANTONIO
text_entry: What stuff tis made of, whereof it is born,

speaker: ANTONIO
text_entry: I am to learn;

speaker: ANTONIO
text_entry: And such a want-wit sadness makes of me,

speaker: ANTONIO
text_entry: That I have much ado to know myself.

speaker: SALARINO
text_entry: Your mind is tossing on the ocean;

speaker: SALARINO
text_entry: There, where your argosies with portly sail,

speaker: SALARINO
text_entry: Like signiors and rich burghers on the flood,

speaker: SALARINO
text_entry: Or, as it were, the pageants of the sea,

speaker: SALARINO
text_entry: Do overpeer the petty traffickers,

speaker: SALARINO
text_entry: That curtsy to them, do them reverence,

speaker: SALARINO
text_entry: As they fly by them with their woven wings.

speaker: SALANIO
text_entry: Believe me, sir, had I such venture forth,

speaker: SALANIO
text_entry: The better part of my affections would

speaker: SALANIO
text_entry: Be with my hopes abroad. I should be still

speaker: SALANIO
text_entry: Plucking the grass, to know where sits the wind,

speaker: SALANIO
text_entry: Peering in maps for ports and piers and roads;

speaker: SALANIO
text_entry: And every object that might make me fear

speaker: SALANIO
text_entry: Misfortune to my ventures, out of doubt

speaker: SALANIO
text_entry: Would make me sad.

speaker: SALARINO
text_entry: My wind cooling my broth

speaker: SALARINO
text_entry: Would blow me to an ague, when I thought

speaker: SALARINO
text_entry: What harm a wind too great at sea might do.

speaker: SALARINO
text_entry: I should not see the sandy hour-glass run,

speaker: SALARINO
text_entry: But I should think of shallows and of flats,

speaker: SALARINO
text_entry: And see my wealthy Andrew dockd in sand,

speaker: SALARINO
text_entry: Vailing her high-top lower than her ribs

speaker: SALARINO
text_entry: To kiss her burial. Should I go to church

speaker: SALARINO
text_entry: And see the holy edifice of stone,

speaker: SALARINO
text_entry: And not bethink me straight of dangerous rocks,

speaker: SALARINO
text_entry: Which touching but my gentle vessels side,

speaker: SALARINO
text_entry: Would scatter all her spices on the stream,

speaker: SALARINO
text_entry: Enrobe the roaring waters with my silks,

speaker: SALARINO
text_entry: And, in a word, but even now worth this,

speaker: SALARINO
text_entry: And now worth nothing? Shall I have the thought

speaker: SALARINO
text_entry: To think on this, and shall I lack the thought

speaker: SALARINO
text_entry: That such a thing bechanced would make me sad?

speaker: SALARINO
text_entry: But tell not me; I know, Antonio

speaker: SALARINO
text_entry: Is sad to think upon his merchandise.

speaker: ANTONIO
text_entry: Believe me, no: I thank my fortune for it,

speaker: ANTONIO
text_entry: My ventures are not in one bottom trusted,

speaker: ANTONIO
text_entry: Nor to one place; nor is my whole estate

speaker: ANTONIO
text_entry: Upon the fortune of this present year:

speaker: ANTONIO
text_entry: Therefore my merchandise makes me not sad.

speaker: SALARINO
text_entry: Why, then you are in love.

speaker: ANTONIO
text_entry: Fie, fie!

speaker: SALARINO
text_entry: Not in love neither? Then let us say you are sad,

speaker: SALARINO
text_entry: Because you are not merry: and twere as easy

speaker: SALARINO
text_entry: For you to laugh and leap and say you are merry,

speaker: SALARINO
text_entry: Because you are not sad. Now, by two-headed Janus,

speaker: SALARINO
text_entry: Nature hath framed strange fellows in her time:

speaker: SALARINO
text_entry: Some that will evermore peep through their eyes

speaker: SALARINO
text_entry: And laugh like parrots at a bag-piper,

speaker: SALARINO
text_entry: And other of such vinegar aspect

speaker: SALARINO
text_entry: That theyll not show their teeth in way of smile,

speaker: SALARINO
text_entry: Though Nestor swear the jest be laughable.

speaker: SALARINO
text_entry: Enter BASSANIO, LORENZO, and GRATIANO

speaker: SALANIO
text_entry: Here comes Bassanio, your most noble kinsman,

speaker: SALANIO
text_entry: Gratiano and Lorenzo. Fare ye well:

speaker: SALANIO
text_entry: We leave you now with better company.

speaker: SALARINO
text_entry: I would have stayd till I had made you merry,

speaker: SALARINO
text_entry: If worthier friends had not prevented me.

speaker: ANTONIO
text_entry: Your worth is very dear in my regard.

speaker: ANTONIO
text_entry: I take it, your own business calls on you

speaker: ANTONIO
text_entry: And you embrace the occasion to depart.

speaker: SALARINO
text_entry: Good morrow, my good lords.

speaker: BASSANIO
text_entry: Good signiors both, when shall we laugh? say, when?

speaker: BASSANIO
text_entry: You grow exceeding strange: must it be so?

speaker: SALARINO
text_entry: Well make our leisures to attend on yours.

speaker: SALARINO
text_entry: Exeunt Salarino and Salanio

speaker: LORENZO
text_entry: My Lord Bassanio, since you have found Antonio,

speaker: LORENZO
text_entry: We two will leave you: but at dinner-time,

speaker: LORENZO
text_entry: I pray you, have in mind where we must meet.

speaker: BASSANIO
text_entry: I will not fail you.

speaker: GRATIANO
text_entry: You look not well, Signior Antonio;

speaker: GRATIANO
text_entry: You have too much respect upon the world:

speaker: GRATIANO
text_entry: They lose it that do buy it with much care:

speaker: GRATIANO
text_entry: Believe me, you are marvellously changed.

speaker: ANTONIO
text_entry: I hold the world but as the world, Gratiano;

speaker: ANTONIO
text_entry: A stage where every man must play a part,

speaker: ANTONIO
text_entry: And mine a sad one.

speaker: GRATIANO
text_entry: Let me play the fool:

speaker: GRATIANO
text_entry: With mirth and laughter let old wrinkles come,

speaker: GRATIANO
text_entry: And let my liver rather heat with wine

speaker: GRATIANO
text_entry: Than my heart cool with mortifying groans.

speaker: GRATIANO
text_entry: Why should a man, whose blood is warm within,

speaker: GRATIANO
text_entry: Sit like his grandsire cut in alabaster?

speaker: GRATIANO
text_entry: Sleep when he wakes and creep into the jaundice

speaker: GRATIANO
text_entry: By being peevish? I tell thee what, Antonio--

speaker: GRATIANO
text_entry: I love thee, and it is my love that speaks--

speaker: GRATIANO
text_entry: There are a sort of men whose visages

speaker: GRATIANO
text_entry: Do cream and mantle like a standing pond,

speaker: GRATIANO
text_entry: And do a wilful stillness entertain,

speaker: GRATIANO
text_entry: With purpose to be dressd in an opinion

speaker: GRATIANO
text_entry: Of wisdom, gravity, profound conceit,

speaker: GRATIANO
text_entry: As who should say I am Sir Oracle,

speaker: GRATIANO
text_entry: And when I ope my lips let no dog bark!

speaker: GRATIANO
text_entry: O my Antonio, I do know of these

speaker: GRATIANO
text_entry: That therefore only are reputed wise

speaker: GRATIANO
text_entry: For saying nothing; when, I am very sure,

speaker: GRATIANO
text_entry: If they should speak, would almost damn those ears,

speaker: GRATIANO
text_entry: Which, hearing them, would call their brothers fools.

speaker: GRATIANO
text_entry: Ill tell thee more of this another time:

speaker: GRATIANO
text_entry: But fish not, with this melancholy bait,

speaker: GRATIANO
text_entry: For this fool gudgeon, this opinion.

speaker: GRATIANO
text_entry: Come, good Lorenzo. Fare ye well awhile:

speaker: GRATIANO
text_entry: Ill end my exhortation after dinner.

speaker: LORENZO
text_entry: Well, we will leave you then till dinner-time:

speaker: LORENZO
text_entry: I must be one of these same dumb wise men,

speaker: LORENZO
text_entry: For Gratiano never lets me speak.

speaker: GRATIANO
text_entry: Well, keep me company but two years moe,

speaker: GRATIANO
text_entry: Thou shalt not know the sound of thine own tongue.

speaker: ANTONIO
text_entry: Farewell: Ill grow a talker for this gear.

speaker: GRATIANO
text_entry: Thanks, i faith, for silence is only commendable

speaker: GRATIANO
text_entry: In a neats tongue dried and a maid not vendible.

text_entry: who, God bless the mark, is a kind of devil; and, to
